items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the band had Don Alias and Keith and Gary Bartz

ctx.x: So do you remember what year or what precipitated your leaving Miles?

I think it was ‘70. Because Ndugu Leon Chancler went to Europe with Miles and the band had Don Alias and Keith and Gary Bartz. When they came back from the summer, Miles called me. They had a few more gigs. Did New York City, maybe one or two other gigs and then I left. I just wanted a change of scenery. I wanted to play a little freer.
